newsitem.title: USA: Three exchanges to list Ascent options.
newsitem.headline: Three exchanges to list Ascent options.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX), Pacific Exchange (PCX) and Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said Monday they will begin trading options on shares of Ascent Entertainment Group on July 8.
The options will open with strike prices of 7-1/2, 10 and 12-1/2, with position limits of 4,500 contracts. Expirations will be in August, September, November and February.

At the AMEX, the specialist unit for the options will be AGS Specialist Partners and at the PHLX, the specialist will be Spear, Leeds & Kellogg. The options have been allocated to lead market maker Sheldon Kahn at the PCX.
